items.inspection_scope: Profile/wear/back-to-back and seats/retention, leakage/temperature/noise, bearing setting and axlebox guides.
items.accountable_basis: Wheelset/bearing specialist; adopted new/worn limits and NDT/fit procedures.

items.inspection_scope: Spring/damper/guide wear and freedom, stops/retention, frame joints, pivot/sidebearer law and hoses through accepted motions.
items.accountable_basis: Running-gear engineer + qualified maintenance; actual movement/wear/lubrication data.

items.inspection_scope: Exact OEM lining/drum/cam/slack/chamber inspection, stroke/clearance and release; custom hub/carrier/torque-joint/retention condition and service access.
items.accountable_basis: Brake/OEM and structural specialists; exact delivered component and custom joint limits.

items.inspection_scope: Reservoir/protection/dryer/drain condition, hoses/connectors/cocks/valves, branch response, leakage/reserve and mechanical service/spring behavior.
items.accountable_basis: Brake/pneumatic specialist; actual schematic, protection/inspection basis and accepted timing.

items.inspection_scope: Bearing/pin/clevis/draft/secondary retention, wear/slack/cracks/locking, articulation, frame attachment and protected hoses.
Actual joints/receivers/corrosion/drainage; hardpoint bypass/fasteners/panel inserts/seams/movement/moisture and separate accessible supports.
items.accountable_basis: Structural/materials engineer; adopted inspection access and defect thresholds.

items.inspection_scope: Roof/wall/opening joints, seals/drainage, glazing retention/emergency release, stairs/guards/gates/lift/bridge locks and actual interlocks/recovery.
items.accountable_basis: Body/accessibility/boarding specialists and exact equipment OEMs.

items.inspection_scope: Exact engine and hydrostatic drive service, mounts/coupling/shafts/gearcase, fluid/filter/heat/exhaust/DPF and fuel protection.
items.accountable_basis: Actual engine/drive manuals + drivetrain engineer; no trailer/coach interval substitution.

items.inspection_scope: Source/changeover/protection/bonding/moving cables, reserve battery/charger, HVAC filters/airflow/clamps/drains/intakes, emergency lights and communications.
items.accountable_basis: Electrical/HVAC specialists; actual nameplates, protection tests and OEM schedule.

items.inspection_scope: Survey gauge/profile/crosslevel/twist/clearance, rail/joints/ties/fasteners/turnouts/crossings, ballast/formation/drainage, station interfaces/access and protection.
items.accountable_basis: Track/civil/survey specialists; released geometry/defect criteria; qualified supervised crew tasks.

event_triggers: Preopening and prescribed shift observations under accepted plan
Impact, derailment, unusual noise/heat/drag/leak or observed component movement
Track washout/settlement/extreme weather or station/interface change
Component removal, caging/release, repair, software/control change or recoupling
Engineer-defined break-in, scheduled maintenance, overhaul or fatigue inspection
interval_rule: Engineer/OEM sets actual hour/distance/cycle/calendar/condition intervals and whichever-first logic for this rail duty. Trailer mileage tables are not imported. Record operating exposure to support later evidence-based revision.
